title: Diffuse to Compress: Leveraging Diffusion LMs for Lossless Compression
abstract: arXiv:2608.11249v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study the problem of lossless text compression, motivated by the rapid growth in the collection and storage of digital textual data - including plain text, source code, and structured formats such as XML - and by recent advances in neural language model-based compression. In particular, recent LLM-based approaches, whether built on symbol-ranking pipelines or paired with a statistical compressor, have demonstrated compression ratios significantly superior to general-purpose compressors such as zstd, gzip, or bzip on text and code. However, these neural approaches suffer from severe throughput limitations, making them not yet practically usable.   For the first time in the context of lossless neural text compression, we introduce Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) as an alternative inference paradigm to autoregressive LLM-based approaches. translated_title: 扩散压缩：利用扩散语言模型实现无损压缩
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.11249v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：我们研究无损文本压缩问题，其动机源于数字文本数据（包括纯文本、源代码以及XML等结构化格式）的收集和存储快速增长，以及近期基于神经语言模型的压缩技术的进步。特别是，近期基于LLM的方法，无论是基于符号排序流程还是与统计压缩器配对，在文本和代码上展现的压缩比显著优于通用压缩器（如zstd、gzip或bzip）。然而，这些神经方法存在严重的吞吐量限制，使其尚不实用。在无损神经文本压缩的背景下，我们首次引入扩散语言模型（DLMs）作为自回归LLM方法的替代推理范式。我们认为，在同一压缩框架内用DLMs替换自回归LLMs，可能解决吞吐量瓶颈并保持高压缩性能。
tldr: 本文首次将扩散语言模型应用于无损文本压缩，替代自回归LLM以解决吞吐量限制，同时保持高压缩比。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces diffusion language models for lossless text compression, replacing autoregressive LLMs to address throughput limitations while maintaining high compression ratios.
